name: Chrome DevTools
description: Control and inspect a live Chrome browser from your coding agent. Get performance traces, network and console analysis, screenshots, and reliable puppeteer-driven automation, all backed by Chrome DevTools.

auth.instructions: No credentials required. The server launches a Chrome instance on first use. Requires a current stable version of Chrome (or Chrome for Testing) on the host. Add --headless for headless mode or --slim for a reduced tool set. Pass --no-usage-statistics to opt out of Google's anonymous usage collection.
